# Executive Matrix

What the repository detects, how far each detection is proven, and what is still open. Counted by `tools/chain.py` on every build; a cell changes only when the repository changes.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Detections** | 22 (18 single-event rules, 4 correlations) across 17 ATT&CK techniques and 10 tactics |
| **Platforms** | Windows, Active Directory, Linux, web applications |
| **Proven in the repository** | 22 of 22 SIEM-Ready: tests, rule mutation proof, KQL and SPL parity, evasion fuzzing · Engineering Score 100/100 |
| **Replayed on public data** | 16/22 detections fire on the pinned public attack data that records their behaviour · 114 in-sample files from 3 sources (219 with the held-out files) · 253 alerts on the recorded attacks, 555 on the labs' own activity (each explained), 1 labelled false positive on these lab captures · held-out: 25 of 26 expectations met, in 23 of 105 files labelled before their first replay ([public data](../docs/PUBLIC_DATA_VALIDATION.md)) |
| **Behaviour proofs** | 81 variants of documented attacker behaviour over 16 detections: 37 proven for every event, 18 known gaps (each shown by an engine-confirmed event), 26 exclusions proven quiet ([certificates](../docs/CERTIFICATES.md)) |
| **Edit equivalence** | `rasd certify --equiv REF` compares every rule with its version at a git ref and proves the edit preserves every event's verdict, or shows the event it changes ([CERTIFY](../docs/CERTIFY.md#comparing-two-versions-of-a-rule)) |
| **Deception** | 7 decoys (2 account, 1 spn, 3 file, 1 service) read by 4 deception detections and touched by 3 red tests · inventory, rules, tests, red tests and the decoy host's configuration agree · 5 decoy classes planned ([DECEPTION](../docs/DECEPTION.md), [inventory](../deceive/)) |
| **Evidence survivability** | 94 detection-question pairs over 18 detections: 38 out of reach, 0 evident, 56 exposed to a sequence that raises no alert · 3 rules on anti-forensic traces would leave 0 exposed · 31 artifacts, 16 anti-forensic actions, documented behaviour pending lab runs ([TRACE](../docs/TRACE.md), [results](../dfir/trace/)) |
| **Evidence of absence** | 10 sensor proofs, 12 records that end one and 2 kinds of time off modelled · on the sample fleet (8 hosts, 2221 records): 99 detection-host pairs, 80 attested (76 by record sequence, 4 by rhythm), 5 fired, 14 unattested · 3 breaks in the record found · documented behaviour pending lab runs ([SILENCE](../docs/SILENCE.md), [results](../dfir/silence/)) |
| **The unseen route** | 16 behaviours over 6 stages, 23 ways around replayed through the engine (22 raise no alert) · on the sample fleet (8 hosts): 12 routes from an origin to a target, 6 unseen end to end and 6 seen on the way (6 of them on rules with no behaviour spec) · 1 change is the fewest after which every route is seen (by leg 3) · documented behaviour pending lab runs ([BLINDPATH](../docs/BLINDPATH.md), [results](../purple/blindpath/)) |
| **Detection health** | 5 watchdog searches in SPL and KQL over the 16 kinds of event the rules read, each row naming the detections it blinds; generated, and the SPL ones ran to the end on Splunk Enterprise 10.4.5 beside 3 lab hosts in the kept lab run · on the sample (8 hosts, a baseline of 2794 events, then a day of 795): 4 detections blind, 13 degraded, 4 healthy, 1 with nothing to compare ([HEALTH](../docs/HEALTH.md), [watchdogs](../queries/health/README.md)) |
| **RASD-Agent's lane** | 19 candidate detections drafted by a language model and kept by the gates of `rasd grow`, reviewed by no person, and counted in no number of this page but this one; none reaches the core without a person's approval of its exact text ([GOVERNANCE](../docs/GOVERNANCE.md)) · of the 604 techniques and sub-techniques of ATT&CK v20.1 that are drafted on their own, 17 have a core detection, 397 are in the agent's queue and 171 are out of reach of the logs RASD reads ([GROW](../docs/GROW.md), [candidates](../detect/candidates/README.md)) |
| **Validated (lab evidence)** | 15 of 22 · Operational Score 86/100 · 15 of 15 evidence files are recomputed from the raw lab runs kept in the repository on every build (3 parts of 1 run): a rule edited until it no longer fires on its run loses its evidence ([lab runs](../purple/lab_runs/README.md)) |
| **Analyst guidance** | 22 of 22 with triage, response, closure and escalation notes · 17 DFIR playbooks |
| **Measured gaps** | 4 gaps without a detection (ldap_enumeration, privilege_escalation_checks, file_upload_testing, jwt_testing) · 1 posture check without a detection (security_headers_testing) |

**Status:** 15 of 22 detections Verified: each fired on a real attack step in a lab and a live SIEM raised its alert; 7 Blocked, each with the reason and the next step ([status](../status/README.md)).

## Measured gaps

Offensive tests that run today without a detection. Each one is planned, not hidden.

| Test | ATT&CK | State | Planned |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ldap_enumeration](../red/active_directory/ldap_enumeration/) | [T1087.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/002/) | gap | A decoy-account rule (4662 read of a honeypot SPN user, which no legitimate process touches) and a hunt over 1644 for (servicePrincipalName=*) from workstations. |
| [privilege_escalation_checks](../red/linux/privilege_escalation_checks/) | [T1083](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1083/) | gap | A correlation over Sysmon for Linux process creation: find -perm -4000, getcap -r and sudo -l from one parent session within a short window, measured against a Linux administration baseline before it is enabled. |
| [file_upload_testing](../red/web/file_upload_testing/) | [T1505.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/) | gap | A WAF-log rule for executable or double extensions on upload endpoints, once a WAF log source is mapped. |
| [jwt_testing](../red/web/jwt_testing/) | [T1606](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1606/) | gap | A rule on application logs for JWT validation failures with algorithm none, once an application log source is mapped. |
| [security_headers_testing](../red/web/security_headers_testing/) | - | posture check | configuration review, no detection expected |

Cloud, email, WAF and network detections are not in the repository: the [roadmap](../docs/RELEASE_ROADMAP.md#after-v20-new-data-domains) lists the data each one needs first.
